name: Facilities by ADF plc
summary: ADF plc specializes in delivering top-tier, managed production facilities for the film and high-end television sectors. The company operates throughout the United Kingdom and continental Europe. Its comprehensive fleet consists of 514 mobile units, which include dedicated trailers for make-up, wardrobe, and performers, alongside portable production offices, bathrooms, dining areas, school rooms, and specialized technical support vehicles. The firm was established in 1992 and is headquartered in Bridgend, UK.
